title: SPACE: Sample-cloud Predictive Adaptive Conformal Ellipsoids for Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2608.17333v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern probabilistic time-series forecasters often express uncertainty through forecast samples. While typically converted into nominal prediction regions using empirical quantiles, these model-implied sets lack formal coverage guarantees and frequently deviate from nominal targets under distribution shift. Existing multivariate conformal methods can calibrate these regions online, but they typically estimate geometry from historical residuals using fixed or accumulating look-back windows. This reliance on the past limits their ability to exploit the instantaneous dependence structure of current predictions and leaves them vulnerable to stale-regime contamination. To address this, we propose SPACE, a conformal wrapper for sample-generating multivariate forecasters. translated_title: SPACE：面向多变量时间序列预测的样本云预测自适应共形椭圆
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.17333v1 公告类型：交叉摘要：现代概率时间序列预测器通常通过预测样本来表达不确定性。虽然通常使用经验分位数将其转换为名义预测区域，但这些模型隐含的集合缺乏正式的覆盖保证，并且在分布偏移下经常偏离名义目标。现有的多变量共形方法可以在线校准这些区域，但它们通常使用固定或累积的回看窗口从历史残差中估计几何形状。这种对过去的依赖限制了它们利用当前预测的瞬时依赖结构的能力，并使其容易受到陈旧状态污染的损害。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了SPACE，一种用于样本生成多变量预测器的共形包装器。SPACE通过直接从当前预测样本云中估计时间局部协方差几何来构建椭球联合预测区域，校准该区域的...
tldr: 本文提出SPACE方法，通过直接从当前预测样本云估计时间局部协方差几何来构建椭球预测区域，克服了传统共形方法依赖历史残差和易受分布偏移影响的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SPACE, a conformal wrapper that constructs ellipsoidal prediction regions by estimating time-local covariance geometry directly from current forecast sample clouds, overcoming limitations of historical-residual reliance and distribution shift vulnerability in existing methods.
